title: dexcli agents-tui --describe output
description: The one JSON object dexcli agents-tui --describe prints on stdout. It lists, for every contract version this dexcli supports, the modes it runs, the local request methods each mode may call, and the capabilities it reads. A launcher picks a contract from it before the handoff. See TERMINAL_UI_CONTRACT.md.
$comment: Patterns end with (?![\s\S]) rather than $, because Python's re lets $ match before a trailing newline and ECMAScript does not. Objects allow unknown properties, because a later dexcli may add fields.

contracts.description: Keyed by the contract version as a decimal string without leading zeros, such as "1".

uses_methods.description: The local request methods this mode may call when the launch document lists them.

capabilities.description: The launch document capabilities this dexcli reads; it ignores others.
